goal: Make Kakashi Learning outperform imitation by selecting transferable methods, using Hermes-native strengths and evaluating gain against the incumbent skill

context.task: Improve this public-source repository after inspecting similar skill workflows
context.environment: Hermes desktop, local skill source and Python standard-library tests
assumptions: The incumbent is this repository's v0.2 skill; no old-version behavioral baseline was captured
missing_capabilities: No authorized fresh-session activation comparison on this revision

discovery.budget: Four targeted web searches; four selected repositories inspected at full SHAs
discovery.stop_reason: Relevant diversity achieved: authoring/benchmark, discovery, overlap assessment, trigger evaluation; further search deferred without evidence gap

metrics.name: transfer clarity
metrics.target: Each proposed method explains upstream principle, incumbent, Hermes implementation, advantage and failure condition
metrics.method: Manual review of skill and report template
metrics.baseline: v0.2 filter did not require explicit transfer-versus-imitation comparison
metrics.observation: v0.3 source and report template now require it; whether agents obey is not tested

metrics.name: routing coverage
metrics.target: Representative trigger, non-trigger and boundary prompts are defined, then verified with skill activation
metrics.method: Check dataset structure, then run old/new on same prompts in isolated sessions
metrics.observation: Dataset structure tested; activation runs not performed

metrics.name: measured user benefit
metrics.target: New revision beats incumbent on a representative goal without a safety regression
metrics.method: Controlled paired old/new run, output grading and user review
metrics.baseline: No version-pinned behavioral result for v0.2
